alert.none: You don’t have an active membership.

portal.noUrl: Unable to open the Stripe portal.
portal.offlineTitle: You must be online to open the billing portal.

updateCard.title: Update card
updateCard.body: Subscription → Payment method (opens the Stripe customer portal) to add a card and set it as default.

cancelRenewal.title: Cancel renewal
cancelRenewal.body: Subscription → Manage (in the Stripe portal) then disable renewal. Premium access remains active until the end of the period.

invoices.title: Invoices / Receipts
invoices.body: Subscription → Invoices (in the Stripe portal) to download receipts generated by Stripe. A Stripe confirmation email is sent after each payment.
